_about: OoOLyzer config for workloads/toffoli (masked Toffoli gate).
_arch_map_note: x10/x13 = variable a's shares; x11/x14 = b's shares; x12/x15 = c's shares (the accumulated outputs). The paper's danger pairs {a0,a3},{a1,a4},{a2,a5} are exactly these.
_reused_note: t0 (x5) holds a0b0 -> a0b1 -> a1b1 -> a1b0 in succession; consecutive writes to its physical register are RIL candidates mixing share-0 and share-1 products.

cross_domain_operand_sites._note: Instructions reading one operand from each domain (ALU/computation-level recombination, reported under IEW/co-residency, not RIL).
